title: Unfreed objects can cause a crash when closing the game
body:

- Reproducible in v4.7.dev.custom_build [64596092a]
- Not reproducible in v4.7.dev2.official [778cf54da]

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev (1446ad96c) - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7680) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13600KF (20 threads) - 47.84 GiB memory

### Issue description

This crash is linked to an unfreed object. I’m not sure whether this qualifies as a bug, but it would be extremely difficult for users to trace the crash back to an unfreed object. For this reason, there may still be room for improvement in this area.

main.gd:
```
extends Node3D

func _ready() -> void:
	var conf_manager = ConfManager.new()
	conf_manager.get_conf("res://config.cfg")
	#conf_manager.free() # ------------> If not free this object, will crash when close game.
	printt(111111)
```

conf_manager.gd:
```
extends Object
class_name ConfManager

var _conf_map: Dictionary = {}

func get_conf(path: String):
	if _conf_map.has(path):
		return _conf_map.get(path)
		
	var conf := ConfigFile.new()
	conf.load(path)
	_conf_map[path] = conf
	return conf
```
### Steps to reproduce

- Import MRP
- Run from Project List then close, see the console. Or open the project then run it and close it, see the console.

[test-crash-20260325.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26224932/test-crash-20260325.zip)
